question: Would reducing this candidate shift a relevant patient CD4 state away from an inflammatory programme, without simply losing the cells?

dataset.source: Illustrative study manifest; no patient dataset downloaded or analysed
dataset.reference: Within-lineage reference CD4 states, subject to biological review; not an assumed healthy destination

adaptation.plan: Reserve evaluation donors before preprocessing that learns from data or model adaptation; assess whether patient-data adaptation improves the intended representation.
adaptation.split: Illustrative split: ILL-D01–04 development; ILL-D05–08 held out. These invented counts are not a sample-size recommendation.

model.name: Unselected partner model service
model.operation: Model-supported gene perturbation; exact operation not yet selected
model.output: State-shift nomination; not a predicted IL-17A percentage
model.intended_use: Prioritise a target intervention and a represented CD4 state for biological testing
model.validation: Not established; a real study requires task-relevant evaluation, simple baselines and perturbation evidence
model.baseline: Compare against an unadapted model and informative simple baselines; include unchanged-input and control perturbations

boundaries: Published psoriasis background is context, not evidence for fictional DEMO-R1.
All replay outcomes are invented examples, not results from patient cells or a trained foundation model.
Observational adaptation does not establish causal perturbation accuracy.
Embedding change, transcript reduction and antibody blockade are different interventions or outputs.
Patient skin and a stimulated culture are not equivalent; transportability must be reviewed.
Selective producer loss, reduced production among survivors and mixed mechanisms remain competing explanations.
Differentiation from existing treatments is an untested hypothesis; no superiority, safety or clinical benefit is established.

readouts: IL-17A-positive fraction among live CD4 cells
Survival, activation/stress and cytokine production per survivor as appropriate
biological_test.criteria: Agree useful effect, QC, precision and failure criteria before seeing results; do not automatically inherit the legacy assay threshold.
